rec.name: Testimonials Section (3 Styles: Quote Slider, Card Carousel, Card Grid)
rec.status: Built — tested internally (3 testers), KVA approved, launched

what.text: A reusable Shopify section for showing customer testimonials on any page. It ships as three separate sections, each with its own logic: (1) 'Testimonials': a centered, large-quote slider with a star rating, author name and dots/arrows. (2) 'Testimonials two': a horizontally scrolling card carousel with a headline, prev/next arrows, a product/review image, name with 'Verified Buyer', stars, review text and a linked product row. (3) 'Testimonials three': a card layout of image, name, stars, text and product link, which stacks on mobile. The original ticket also asks for a headline, sub-headline, CTA button, an optional badge ('300,000 customers love Doonails') and video-thumbnail testimonials with a play icon (up to 15). Those video/badge items are not visible in any final screenshot.

why.text: Real customer voices are one of the strongest social-proof signals. Star ratings and 'Verified Buyer' labels add credibility, which lowers purchase risk. Names, photos and real quotes make the proof concrete and relatable. Showing the purchased product beside each review links the proof to a product and gives a quick path to it. A badge with a large customer count (e.g. '300,000 customers') adds bandwagon proof, and video testimonials add authenticity.

how.text: Create the section files in the theme (Impact base). Style 1 is a Flickity carousel with fade, wrap-around and adaptive height, plus a shared snippet 'ed-flickity-control' for dots and optional prev/next arrows. Each testimonial is a block with rating (1–5), text and author. Stars are rendered by looping filled and empty 'rating-star' icons up to 5. A decorative quote mark is drawn with a CSS mask, and the mobile layout shrinks the quote mark and stars. The background colour is injected via a section-scoped style. Styles 2 and 3 follow the Sleek-style card design (image, name + Verified Buyer, stars, text, product row) and were built as separate sections ('Testimonials two' and 'Testimonials three'); their code is not in the file provided. After internal testing, mobile fixes were made: tighter spacing, wider cards so the next card peeks, a larger gap between title and cards, stars that follow the rating, and a stack of a single card.

items: Per testimonial block: star rating 1–5, review text, author name (code, style 1)
Per card in styles 2/3: image/thumbnail, name, 'Verified Buyer' label, review text, linked product (inferred from screenshots)
Ticket spec (not verified in screenshots): text colour, corner style rounded vs. square, headline, sub-headline, CTA button
Ticket spec (not verified in screenshots): optional badge with show/hide toggle, badge background and text colour
Ticket spec (not verified in screenshots): thumbnail, text and video play-button icon per testimonial, up to 15 video testimonials

dependencies.text: Shopify theme 'Impact' (uses <flickity-carousel> and <flickity-controls> custom elements, the 'icon' snippet with 'rating-star', 'nav-arrow-left'/'nav-arrow-right' icons, and the 'general.accessibility.*' translation keys). Needs the snippet 'ed-flickity-control.liquid'. Design reference for the card styles is the 'Sleek' theme. The section files are 'ed-testimonials-one.liquid' (named 'CRO | Testimonial 01') plus the 'Testimonials two' and 'Testimonials three' sections. No metafields or apps are needed for style 1. Linked products in styles 2/3 presumably use product pickers (inferred).

items: Conversion rate on pages with the section (A/B vs. without)
Click-through rate on product links inside review cards
Video play rate (if video testimonials are used)

Design reference for style 3: a 4-card grid with a centered name, stars, review text and underlined product link under a centered headline.
